cohort: 60 pregnant women who underwent cesarean delivery with coexisting placenta accreta and placenta previa
finding: Both intra-aortic balloon occlusion (IABO) and internal iliac artery balloon occlusion (IIABO) are safe and effective for cesarean delivery in patients with combined placenta accreta and placenta previa, but IABO is associated with shorter operation time, balloon occlusion time, and fetal radiation dose.
